notes.title: Luckslinger 2.0 patch
notes.notes:
The main changes for the game are:
[list]
[*] More checkpoints in each level! Keeping the clutch gameplay intact but a bit more forgiving overall
[*] Luckslinger now has stronger leg muscles and can jump higher
[*] Playstation controller support!
[*] In the saloon you can acquire another extra HP, allowing the opportunity for 5 HP max
[*] More health, luck and money drops
[*] Other small fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Luckslinger Update: Luck fix, difficulty setting
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

We’ve heard your suggestions and we're excited to announce the new patch that we've just released, the new patch contains the following:

[list]
[*]The game now saves half of your Luck when you reach a checkpoint, so when you die you don’t lose all your Luck, but keep half of it. We changed this because when you lose all your Luck you lose part of your momentum and felt (too) punishing. 
[*]We offer 2 difficulties, instead of the ‘default’ difficulty. The difficulties are ‘New School’ and ‘Old School’. 
[list]
[*][b]New School:[/b] With the New school difficulty, the way that the checkpoints behave is changed. Now when you die three times, you don’t have to start from the beginning of the level again, you can continue from your last checkpoint.
[*][b]Old School:[/b] The Old School difficulty works the same as the ‘default’ difficulty, so when you die three times you have to redo the whole level.
[/list]

[*] There is also a New Game+ (called ‘Side B’), which you can only unlock if you beat the game in Old School mode.
[*] If you already have a save file for the game and want to switch difficulties, you don’t have to start all over. When you load up your file you can just go to the [b]pause menu > settings[/b], where you can switch the difficulty mode. 
[/list]

Hope you enjoy the new patch and that some of you can get ahead in Luckslinger :)

notes.title: Luck patch, bug fixes and other small fixes
notes.notes:
Hey all,

We've just released our first patch for Luckslinger, this patch includes:

[list]
[*] A bugfix at the Blondies boss where she could get stuck behind your Shield
[*] A small typo fix (burry > bury)
[*] Some balancing changes, we made SadHill a bit easier
[*] We made Sean a bit easier (first boss)
[*] We made Goldberg a bit easier
[*] Made some changed to RoadToClovercreek
[*] Changed the luck-on-die, now when you reach a checkpoint, half of your Luck is saved. So when you die, you don't lose all your luck, but you will have half of the luck that you had when you reached the checkpoint
[/list]
